# SSP-120: Final 47-tile kerb blob autotile generated by rule

**Milestone:** [M4 Art Pass 1](../README.md#m4) · **Type:** asset · **Size:** M · **Areas:** assets, tooling · **Vertical slice**

## Summary

Generate the final 47-tile kerb blob autotile set from rule parameters in `kerb_blob.json`, replacing the M1 placeholder set under the same frame IDs. Kerbs carry Kerb Hugger gameplay and gutter grime, so they must read cleanly.

## Context

Kerbs (ART_BIBLE §9.1): 06 top, 07 NW lip, 04 SE lip, 01 gutter line; a 47-tile blob autotile generated by rule. Never hand-edit the 47 tiles; change the rule params in `assets-src/procedural/tiles/kerb_blob.json` (ASSET_PIPELINE §10.8). The kerb top face is always 06 with a 07 NW lip and 04 SE lip (ART_BIBLE §5.3). State `blob`, index 0-46 (proposed in ART_BIBLE §14.4); keep whatever frame IDs the M1 placeholder used. Dropped kerbs (`d` in the legend) have no kerb edge. Kerbs must join asphalt and pavement slabs seamlessly. Gutter grime sits in a 4-8 px band against the kerb. Kerb Hugger = a gutter brush within 0.2 m (3.2 px) of a kerb edge (GDD).

## Scope

- Rule-based blob generator in `tiles.py` and `kerb_blob.json` params
- pytest: all 47 canonical neighbour configurations covered, every legal neighbour pair joins without a seam, lighting rule (NW lip 07, SE lip 04)
- Manifest upgrade, contact sheet + zoo review

## Out of scope

- Autotile selection logic in `groundLayer` (exists from M1) unless frame IDs force a change
- Gutter grime overlay (SSP-122)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Exactly 47 kerb frames are built from rules; none is hand-edited
- [ ] pytest proves edge continuity for every legal adjacent pair
- [ ] pytest: NW lip pixels are 07 and SE lip pixels are 04 in every frame that has those edges
- [ ] Lint clean; frame IDs unchanged from M1; no `placeholder: true`
- [ ] A Puddle Lane capture (`?test=1&scene=<puddle_lane shift id>&freeze=1`) opened with Read shows no kerb seams

## Verification

- uv run --project tools/forge pytest
- npm run assets && npm run assets:lint && npm run assets:verify
- npm run assets:sheets -- --only <kerb asset id>, then Read build/sheets/only_<kerb asset id>.png
- npm run test:visual
